note: Where every shipped source file under patches/ and extensions/ came from. A rule naming a single file wins over the directory rule around it; otherwise each file matches exactly one rule. A ported rule names the upstream repository, the commit it was copied from, the repositories it came through and its licence, and every file's header names a repository of its rule, by URL. Every upstream named here must also appear in NOTICE. ProvenanceTest checks all of it. HushPinterest started from HushTelegram at 8c54a1d, which started from HushThreads at b141524, which started from Hushfacebook at c15d4f79, so most rules name HushTelegram and carry on the chain the earlier projects recorded for the same files. A Pinterest source named here also has to be allowed by sources/pinterest-sources.json.

Pinterest feed and view filters written for version 14.25.0 from its own dex. Every switch leaves Pinterest's own path in place when it's off or paused, and each hook reports its own capability.
Unchanged. Written for HushTelegram: Register kind analysis written for HushTelegram, so a hook's jump is checked against what ART's verifier accepts before the method changes.

Adapted from HushTelegram's Firebase push repair: the certificate header hook, its startup wait and its request scoping, with Pinterest's package and certificate, Pinterest's two Firebase Installations callers, and HushPinterest's settings and status flags. Telegram's local status readers and push answer hook were left out.

rules.changes: Adapted from Morphe's shared GmsCore support: its permission, action and authority lists, with the identity credentials, App set ID, SMS retriever and ads actions microG-RE 7.2.2 serves only under app.revanced added. Pinterest's own shapes in place of the YouTube fingerprints: Play services' availability check found by its strings, and androidx Credential Manager's framework provider answering unavailable so Android 14 and later fall back to the rerouted Play services path. Every check runs before any edit, and the manifest change is limited to Firebase messaging's c2dm names and a package query. Morphe's checks for an installed GmsCore and its battery optimization prompt were left out.
